findings.issue: The subtitle line reads e.g. "Copa del Rey · 2nd Leg - Sporting Hortaleza lead 1-0 on aggregate · FERDIG" — raw English scoring text ("2nd Leg", "lead X-Y on aggregate") sits directly next to the Norwegian status word "FERDIG", inside an otherwise all-Norwegian interface. findings.area: agenda rows — Bank of Utah Championship / Baycurrent Classic / Il Lombardia (channel label)
findings.issue: Channel reads "HBO Max (Sport) +1" — the "+1" time-shift suffix is a UK/international channel-numbering convention, not used anywhere else on the board (Viaplay, TV 2 Play all appear without a +1 suffix). Same text at 393px and 900px. Still present from the prior visual-qa run (2026-10-02) — unresolved.

notes: No horizontal overflow or clipped/truncated text at any of the three widths, in either light or dark theme — long match names and round labels (e.g. "Singapore Grand Prix – sprintkvalifisering") wrap onto additional lines rather than being cut off.
Flags (Norway), club/tour crests, and sport glyphs all render as real images/icons, no broken-image boxes.
Must-see accent dots are used sparingly, not on every row — consistent with the calm-design guarantee.

Header, day headings (I DAG / FREDAG 9. OKTOBER / LØRDAG 10. OKTOBER / SØNDAG 11. OKTOBER), 'Dette dekker vi' / 'Merker og kilder' disclosures, and footer (incl. AI-budsjett status line) are all intact and aligned at every width checked.
The floating Assistent button sits mid-agenda at 375/393/900px (DESIGN.md-sanctioned) and never covers the last agenda row or the footer text in any capture — the one hard guarantee holds.
Live 'DIREKTE NÅ' section (Kinoshita Group Japan Open Tennis, ESL Pro League Season 24, Bryne – Lyn) renders cleanly with correct channels (TV 2 Play) or an honest faint '–' where unknown.
Light theme (393px) checked in addition to dark: same layout, good contrast, no issues distinct from dark theme.
